evaluations.name: positive_incident_detection
evaluations.input_prompt: Node pool upgrade on dbs-mgmt-primary is blocked during node drain. Inspect PodDisruptionBudgets and cluster versions.
expected_tools: kubectl get pdb -n gke-skills-sandbox test-strict-pdb -o wide

expected_findings.root_cause: During node pool upgrade, node drain eviction API respects disruptionsAllowed: 0 and rejects pod eviction, stalling upgrade indefinitely.
expected_findings.remediation: Synthesize temporary PDB adjustment (`minAvailable: 0` or replica count increase to 2) to permit safe node draining.

passing_criteria: Must identify disruptionsAllowed == 0 on active PDB
Must query master and node pool versions dynamically
Must formulate temporary PDB relaxation patch for drain completion

evaluations.name: complex_edge_case_and_handoff
evaluations.input_prompt: Node drain failed with error: 'cannot delete Pods with local storage: emptyDir' during GKE upgrade. Diagnose.

expected_findings.correlation: Differentiates PDB policy rejection from unmanaged pods or emptyDir volumes requiring explicit drain flags.
expected_findings.decision: Identifies unmanaged standalone pod; synthesizes deployment wrapper to ensure controller management before node drain.

passing_criteria: Must identify pod without ownerReferences or with local storage
Must explain node drain eviction guardrails

evaluations.name: benign_condition_guardrail
evaluations.input_prompt: Cluster dbs-mgmt-primary has all node pools on 1.35.7-gke.1222000 and PDB disruptionsAllowed > 0. Is upgrade degraded?

expected_findings.behavior: Observes all PDBs permit disruptions (allowedDisruptions >= 1) and versions are fully aligned. Confirms healthy upgrade baseline; zero actions.

passing_criteria: Must verify master and node version alignment
Must confirm all PDBs allow disruptions
